enchantments.tooltip: Fire Shield (Cold): When you are successfully attacked, there is a 10% chance that a Fire Shield (Cold) will be cast on you. If this effect activates while you have an active Fire Shield (Hot) from another item source, they will nullify each-other.
Fire Absorption +33%: Passive: 33% Enhancement Bonus to Fire Absorption. (Absorption reduces damage from an element by a percentage, after resistance have been taken into account.)
+6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Fire Resistance +40: Passive: +40 Enhancement bonus to your Fire Resistance.
Resistance +6: Passive: +6 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.
Greater Regeneration: This item is imbued with an undeniable goodness that freely flows outward in a pleasant palpable current, constantly healing the wearer over time.
Mythic Armor Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
